title: Enterprise Transformation
excerpts: We re-architect how an enterprise operates — codifying process controls, governance, and a single source of truth across the functions that run the business. We treat transformation as an operating-model change we stay accountable for, not a software install we hand over.

heroSection.heading: Enterprise Transformation
heroSection.description: We help established organizations modernize the systems and processes their operations depend on. From ERP programs to operating-model redesign, we deliver transformation that holds up under real governance — and we carry production responsibility for what we put live.

whatThisMeansToUs.heading: Transformation is an operating model, not an install
whatThisMeansToUs.description: Large programs fail when they are treated as software projects. We treat them as changes to how an organization actually works, with controls, adoption, and accountability built in from the first phase.

items.title: Process before platform
items.excerpt: We define and baseline the real workflows before we configure anything, so the system encodes how the business should run rather than freezing its current friction.

items.title: Governance is the deliverable
items.excerpt: Approval rigor, traceability, and financial accuracy are the point in control-sensitive industries. We build those controls into the system, not into a binder beside it.

items.title: Phased and low-risk
items.excerpt: We sequence transformation to protect production continuity, validating each phase against agreed workflows before the next one starts.

items.title: Adoption decides value
items.excerpt: A program only pays off when people use it. We design for readiness and adoption so the new operating model sticks after we step back.

howWeDoIt.heading: From process baseline to a governed operating system
howWeDoIt.description: We combine requirements engineering, ERP and platform implementation, and disciplined rollout to stand up systems an enterprise can run on for years.

items.title: Discovery & process baseline
items.excerpt: Structured requirements discovery and management alignment that turn fragmented practices into a validated process model.

items.title: ERP & core systems
items.excerpt: Selective, maintainable configuration of the core platform, mapped to validated workflows and extended only where it earns its keep.

items.title: Integration & data
items.excerpt: Governed interfaces between the core and the systems around it, so data and approvals flow without manual handoffs.

items.title: Rollout & readiness
items.excerpt: Backlog-driven implementation with readiness validation, controlled cutover, and the operational discipline to keep it reliable.

items.title: An Odoo-centered ERP program for an oil-and-gas operator
items.problem: FAROGL faced fragmented workflows and inconsistent process enforcement across key operational areas, with manual handoffs that slowed cycle times and limited enterprise-level visibility.
items.approach: We ran a phased Odoo program — structured requirements discovery, management alignment, and process-baseline definition — then mapped module implementation to validated workflows with controlled, maintainable extension.
items.outcome: A coherent ERP foundation that codifies process controls and gives the organization a lower-risk path to enterprise-wide standardization and future scaling.

items.title: An operating layer for AI-enabled franchise execution
items.problem: Hissho needed consistent execution across thousands of franchise locations, where insight rarely turned into repeatable day-to-day action across fragmented tools.
items.approach: We built the governed, mobile-first application layer between franchise users and Hissho's AI and data platform — role-aware workflows for production planning, ordering, and regional coaching, with permissions, auditable actions, and controlled overrides.
items.outcome: A practical execution surface that turns intelligence into accountable field behavior, consistently, at network scale.

items.title: A sports-facility booking marketplace, concept to production
items.problem: Facility booking relied on phone calls and manual confirmation, leaving operators with low utilization, revenue leakage, and no real-time demand visibility.
items.approach: We built the end-to-end platform — Flutter apps for players, a React operator portal, and a FastAPI backend with ML-ranked search, integrated payments, and demand-based dynamic pricing.
items.outcome: Booking time dropped sharply and operators gained real-time visibility, with strong mobile adoption in the first month after launch.

items.title: Continuum: an AI revenue operating layer
items.problem: Experience-economy operators ran pricing, inventory, and distribution across fragmented tools, with manual interventions and yield leakage.
items.approach: We built a modular, API-first, event-driven platform pairing configurable business rules with model-assisted recommendations, with policy boundaries and override-capable workflows that keep operators in control.
items.outcome: A scalable operating foundation that connects previously siloed revenue levers and supports ongoing product evolution.

items.title: DoYouWork: an integrated field-service platform
items.problem: Amistee's field-service operation ran on fragmented tools and paperwork, with no real-time view of schedules, assets, and approvals, and no self-service for field employees.
items.approach: We built a three-app ecosystem — a Capacitor mobile employee app, a React admin portal, and a FastAPI backend — with role-based access, location-scoped data, multi-tenancy, real-time notifications, and S3-backed approval workflows.
items.outcome: A unified, mobile-first system that replaced manual processes with real-time operational visibility and a scalable foundation for growth.

items.title: End-to-end coaching intelligence, hardware to cloud
items.problem: Bowling analytics depended on expensive fixed installations, forcing a trade-off between affordability and analytical fidelity.
items.approach: We engineered the full product — purpose-built finger-grip sensor hardware, real-time motion processing, high-concurrency cloud ingestion, coaching dashboards, an AI assistant, and OTA firmware updates.
items.outcome: Portable coaching intelligence that preserves signal fidelity at scale, shifting analytics from fixed rigs to a device players can carry.

items.title: An air-gapped LLM application layer
items.problem: Dealer-brokers needed faster access to synthesized information and more relevant retail outreach, without exposing sensitive data to external AI services.
items.approach: We deployed an air-gapped open-source LLM environment and built the extensible application layer over it — an AI assistant for dealer-brokers and behavior-aware retail marketing — with control held at the infrastructure boundary.
items.outcome: A secure, extensible AI foundation that is useful in high-tempo decisions while keeping data inside institutional boundaries.

items.title: Flex5: a HIPAA-grade health platform launch
items.problem: Reality Meets Science needed a production-capable, HIPAA-aligned platform that could launch quickly without accruing compliance or architecture debt.
items.approach: We built the application and platform layer end to end — a mobile-first experience, secure backend services, and an extensible AI orchestration layer for controlled, scalable rollout of coaching and engagement functions.
items.outcome: A launch-ready system with HIPAA-aligned governance and a credible base for enterprise conversations and iterative growth.
